facts.fact: PM-KMY is a separate, voluntary and contributory pension scheme
facts.quote: It is a voluntary and contribution based pension scheme.

facts.fact: The farmer gets a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month from age 60
facts.quote: Under this scheme, the farmers would receive a minimum assured pension of Rs 3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years

facts.fact: The farmer contributes Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month until age 60
facts.quote: Farmers will have to contribute an amount between Rs.55 to Rs.200 per month in the Pension Fund till they reach the retirement date i.e. the age of 60 years.

facts.fact: The Central Government contributes an equal amount
facts.quote: The Central Government will also make an equal contribution of the same amount in the pension fund.
Those farmers who are of the age of 18 years and above and upto 40 years are eligible to join the scheme.

facts.fact: The scheme is for small and marginal farmers
facts.quote: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana is a government scheme meant for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF).

facts.fact: PM-KISAN, by contrast, gives Rs 6,000 a year (not a pension)
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.

summary: PM-KMY: Rs 3,000 a month from 60, farmer pays Rs 55-200 a month with an equal Central share, entry 18-40, small and marginal farmers; all confirmed.
